event: He binds his ember roughly into the welded chain: one with the maul now, its well deeper.
Sitting on the threshold-stone, he meditates on nothing but what is already his.
The haven's pull leans hardest as he rests, and the last measure of wholeness slides away.
Against his set will he feels the shape of the keeper's patient, starving hunger.
He cannot fill both maul and self; he banks the maul to a working charge, himself near-whole.

changes.note: Meditation refills him, less the rough binding and the maul's charge
Meditation eases the climb and the long grapple

event: He feels one true warmth within reach that is not his own: the winding-drum core in his pack.
